prompts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: original desktop application icon for PeerGlide / 屏跃, a Windows/macOS cross-computer keyboard-and-mouse collaboration app.
Create ONE polished production-minded app-icon concept, centered square composition, no words or letters. A rounded-square/squircle cobalt-blue tile with a very restrained cobalt-to-cyan gradient. Inside, a bold simple white geometric symbol: two offset rounded window/portal outlines joined by one elegant continuous folded bridge or glide ribbon across their adjacent edges. The idea is two screens becoming one fluid workspace. Use strong negative space and only a few broad shapes, optically balanced, recognizable at 24px, clean vector-like precision. Contemporary desktop utility identity; confident, friendly, not gaming, not a remote-desktop clone.
Flat front view, subtle depth only in the blue tile, no surrounding cast shadow, no 3D pedestal, no device mockup, no tiny screens/stands/mouse glyphs, no chain-link circles, no lightning bolt, no generic bidirectional arrows, no UU/TeamViewer/AnyDesk/Oink marks, no text or watermark. Keep the full squircle visible with a small transparent safety margin. Truly transparent background outside the opaque icon tile.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop app visual proposal, straight-on flat screenshot, landscape approximately 16:10.
Create ONE extremely polished modern Simplified Chinese interface for “屏跃 / PeerGlide”, a LAN keyboard/mouse multi-computer collaboration utility for Windows + macOS. Input image 1 is our original brand icon: use it unchanged as a small 32px brand mark at top-left, NOT as a background. Brand direction: contemporary professional desktop utility, learn from the clear device-first product presentation of UU Remote without copying any of its assets, logos, IDs, login, VIP or commercial features. This is an original design proposal, not a running software screenshot.

Visual system: bright white and cool very-light-gray surfaces, blue #3A7BFC main actions, subtle cyan detail, almost-black text, clean Chinese sans-serif, 8px spacing system, restrained 10–12px radii, hairline dividers, very subtle shadows. Crisp flat UI, no perspective, no glassmorphism, no neon, no pink, no giant empty monitor canvas as the home screen, no giant pills everywhere. Spacious but purposeful, good contrast, consistent 14–16px body text.
Composition: one complete desktop app window, 1440x900 logical proportions, thin native-like titlebar. Left navigation around 190px. Main content is a device control center with TWO beautiful compact device cards and a clear connection/action strip, then a compact screen-layout preview section. Device details appear only via a drawer, do not create a permanently cluttered third inspector column. No account/login necessary.

Exact text hierarchy:
Brand “屏跃”, small “PeerGlide”.
Sidebar: “总览”, selected “设备与屏幕”, “本机鼠标” with tiny “预览”, “剪贴板与文件” with tiny “开发中”; bottom “设置”.
Top heading “设备与屏幕”, quiet subtitle “一套键鼠，自在穿梭。”, top-right outline action “＋ 添加电脑”. Small always-visible outlined recovery action “恢复本机”.
Content tabs “设备” (selected with blue underline), “屏幕布局”.
Two side-by-side device cards:
1. minimal original laptop illustration with abstract blue screen, “这台 Mac”, subtle “本机” badge, “系统权限已就绪”, secondary text link “重新检查”.
2. original desktop monitor illustration, “Windows 工作电脑”, blue status dot “已连接”, secondary “键鼠尚未开启”, quiet text “接收许可由对方设置”, overflow menu icon.
Below cards a single elegant full-width status/action strip: “两台电脑已连接”, subtext “开启键鼠前，需要双方分别确认。”, ONE strong blue CTA “开启键鼠协同…”, quiet secondary “断开连接”. No other strong CTAs.
Below that section “屏幕位置”, a small restrained preview of two blue outlined main-screen rectangles side by side labelled “本机” and “工作电脑”, subtle connecting line, tiny caption “相对位置示意”, top-right quiet link “调整布局 →”. This preview must not dominate the whole app.
At bottom two low-emphasis capability tiles “本机鼠标 · 窗口内预览” / “剪贴板与文件 · 尚未接通”, no fake enabled switches.
Outside app frame, a small professional caption: “屏跃 · 视觉提案 01” and “设备与状态为设计示例”.
Chinese lettering must be clean and legible. No invented unreadable dense microtext. No branding from other apps. No unsupported feature shown as working. Do not add live remote screen streaming, terminals, scripts, subscriptions, latency numbers, member avatars or extra devices. The result should feel like a finished, modern product design, not a wireframe or a dashboard template.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a second high-fidelity Simplified Chinese PeerGlide / 屏跃 desktop UI concept, using image 1 as the exact reference for the original app branding, blue-white palette, type, nav and component quality.
This screen demonstrates FIRST-TIME ADDING A COMPUTER. Change the underlying device hub to unpaired: one local Mac card plus a clearly empty add-device placeholder, no already-connected Windows card and no active sharing. Dim the background gently and place a beautifully proportioned centered modal approximately 560px wide; no giant blank area, no perspective.
Modal title “添加电脑”, close X. Small three-step progress “1 连接方式” active, “2 核对设备”, “3 完成”.
Two clear segmented choices “显示配对码” (selected) and “输入配对码”.
Main title “让另一台电脑加入工作区”.
Supporting line “在另一台屏跃中选择「输入配对码」。两台电脑需连接同一局域网。”
A large well-kerned blue-on-pale-blue code block “5824 1369” with a small copy icon and accessible text button “复制配对码”.
Below code a simple time icon and “临时配对码 · 本次有效”.
A neutral privacy note with lock icon: “配对只记住设备，不会自动开启键鼠或内容共享。”
A discreet outlined option “允许附近电脑发现本次配对” default OFF, with explanatory small text “仅在你开启后可被附近设备看到”.
Bottom footer secondary “取消”, link “连接遇到问题？” and a quiet waiting state “等待另一台输入”.
NO green success, NO code approved, NO auto consent, NO account/login, NO remote terminal, NO fake live screen.
Use the same original blue linked-screen icon from the reference, all Chinese legible, crisp contemporary utility design, coherent with the device-hub concept.
Outside app frame small caption “屏跃 · 添加电脑视觉提案” and “配对码为设计示例，运行时动态生成”. The code is a visual placeholder, not a real credential.
